seoTitle: Free Random Date Generator: Dates and Times in a Range
metaDescription: Generate random dates and times between two dates in ISO, Unix, RFC 2822 and other formats. Weekdays only, sorted, no duplicates. Free, local.
intro: Creates random dates or timestamps between a start and an end, in the format you need.
why:
Test data, seed files and demos need dates that vary but stay in range. Set a start and an end, choose a format, and get as many values as you want. All times are UTC.

Date-only formats pick a random day, so every day in the range has the same chance. Time formats pick a random millisecond. You can skip weekends, sort the list, and avoid duplicates. The random source is the browser's cryptographic one, without modulo bias.
howTo: Enter a start and end date.
Choose a format and a count.
Tick weekdays only, sorted or no duplicates if needed.

faq.a: Yes. A date-only end covers the whole day.
UTC. Convert if you need local time.

faq.q: Why does it say only some values fit?
faq.a: When duplicates are off or weekends are skipped, the range may hold fewer values than you asked for.

faq.q: Can I get the same dates again?
faq.a: No. The values are random each time, with no seed.
